newsitem.title: BRAZIL: No date set for Brazil cellphone bid specs release.
newsitem.headline: No date set for Brazil cellphone bid specs release.

text.p: Brazil has not set a date yet for publication of bid specifications for B Band frequency cellular telephone concessions slated to be auctioned later this year, a government spokeswoman said.
"No date is foreseen," a Communications Ministry spokeswoman told Reuters. "It probably won't be tomorrow, but it may be next week, it may be the week afterward. We don't know yet.
A decree issued Monday, which delineated the 10 areas nationwide where the government will offer 15-year B Band concessions, said the bid documents would be published "in the coming days."
It did not elaborate on what that meant and officials were not available to explain the apparent delay.

The spokeswoman said merely that Communications Minister Sergio Motta's office had not issued the order yet to publish the much-awaited documents, including base prices, auction dates and other tender details.
In a sign of widespread interest in B Band concessions, 20 foreign-led groups have formed to bid in the auctions, which will open the country's promising cellular market to foreign capital.
The government hopes to begin the tender process early this year and start granting contracts by mid-1997.
